sections.heading: 1. After your massage
lines: ① That evening, take a 10-minute walk.
② Keep up home exercises, once a day.
③ At your desk, stand up every 30–60 min.
④ Shoulder and upper back strength, twice a week.

slides.heading: Worth checking if you notice

caption:
Walked out of your massage feeling brand new, then two days later the tight shoulders were back? Mr Turtle knows that one.

That's pretty normal. For most people, the looser feeling lasts somewhere between a few hours and a few days. Massage changes how muscles and nerves feel, and if the same habits keep loading you up, the tightness tends to return.

You can stretch that window: walk that evening, keep up your home exercises and break up long desk stretches. If pain gets worse after a massage or your arm tingles, get it checked.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help you find a rhythm that works. Book online via the link in bio.
